workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.desc: Select a floor range, generate a summary, confirm to inject.
workspace.rangeHint: “Floor” here just means message order: the first message is 1, the second is 2. Default batch size only affects how many messages the auto-fill action picks at once.
workspace.filterFragmentsPlaceholder:
One keyword or fragment per line.
e.g.: think
comment
<!--img-prompt
workspace.filterHint: One keyword per line. 'think' removes <think>...</think> blocks; 'comment' removes HTML comments; exact fragments are deleted as-is.
workspace.noDraft: No pending summary. Confirmed summaries appear in the Summary tab.
segments.title: Summaries
segments.desc: Confirmed summaries accumulate here. The full text is used for injection.
segments.fusionRecoveryHint: If merge returns empty content, Memoir retries with reinforced recovery prompts. If it still returns empty, the original summaries are preserved as text for manual revision.
settings.title: Settings
settings.responseLengthHint: 0 = follow SillyTavern's global response length. This only limits one model reply, not the total confirmed summary size.
settings.contentCompatibilityEnable: Enable mature content archive compatibility patch
settings.contentCompatibilityHint: Enabled by default. Converts high-intensity mature, violent, biological, or taboo fiction into neutral archive records to reduce empty responses. Turning it off only affects the first normal request; empty-response recovery still enables the compatibility prompt temporarily.
inject.title: Injection Strategy
inject.strategyDesc: Decides which prompt layer the summary enters and its relative position within that layer. This is not an absolute insertion point.
inject.enableDesc: When enabled, confirmed summary text is automatically injected into the conversation context.
inject.positionBeforeHint: Placed before all prompts, with the lowest presence.
inject.positionAfterHint: Placed near the character definition, usually more stable.
inject.positionUnsupported: The current preset does not support the Character Layer. Choose the Top Layer or Chat Injection Layer.
inject.positionChatHint: Inserted into the chat injection layer and ordered alongside other modules in that layer.
inject.depthDesc: Only applies to the chat injection layer. 0 = tries to stay close to the latest message; prompts at the same depth still follow SillyTavern ordering, so this is not guaranteed to be absolutely last. Larger values move it further forward.
inject.depthAutoUnavailable: Automatic positioning requires a continuous hidden history from the beginning that is fully covered by the cumulative summary. Use a manual depth instead.
inject.depthAutoFloorHint: SillyTavern /hide is zero-based while Memoir floors start at 1. To hide Memoir floors 1-60, hide SillyTavern floors 0-59.
inject.wrapTagDesc: If set, injected content is wrapped in <tagname>...</tagname>. Some models pay extra attention to specific tags like paststory or context. Leave empty for no wrapping.
inject.attentionNote: Tip: Closer to the latest message = higher AI attention. For long-chat story summaries, try 'Character Definition' or 'Inside Chat, depth 1-4' with a wrapper tag for best results.
settings.promptHintNewUser: Tip: Start by picking a preset and templates. Only expand to edit the full prompts if you know what to change.
settings.promptVariableHint: Tip: You can paste in your own preferred summary prompt template here. The system prompt has no required variables; in the user template, keep {{start_floor}}, {{end_floor}}, and {{chat_history}}, and you can change the rest.
settings.fusionHint: Fusion has its own prompts, separate from main summarization.
token.counterUnavailable: No token counting interface is available in this SillyTavern build.
token.counterReady: Counts the current cumulative summary text only, without injection wrappers.
toast.invalidRange: Please enter a valid floor range.

toast.contentCompatibilitySaved: Mature content archive compatibility patch saved.
toast.contentCompatibilityReset: Restored mature content archive compatibility default prompt.
toast.fusionFallbackUsed: Fusion API still returned empty content. Original summaries were preserved as text for manual revision.

automation.title: Automation
automation.scope: Applies only to this chat. New chats remain semi-automatic.
automation.hide: Hide source messages after automatic adoption is saved
automation.hint: Each message counts as one floor. Uses saved settings. The Memoir panel may be closed; leave the SillyTavern browser tab running. Automatic generation currently requires an independent API. Switching to semi-automatic does not undo summaries or unhide messages.
automation.save: Save chat rules and check one batch
automation.reason.waiting: Not enough eligible messages for a batch.
automation.reason.user-paused: Paused; existing summaries and visibility are preserved.
automation.reason.manual-operation: Automation paused for a manual operation. Resume when ready.
automation.reason.shared-api-unavailable: The shared API cannot safely isolate background summaries from normal replies. Save an independent API configuration or use semi-automatic mode.
automation.reason.provider-incomplete: Independent API configuration is incomplete. No other API was called.
automation.reason.capability-unavailable: This environment lacks the chat, save, or browser-lock capabilities required for safe automation. Use semi-automatic mode.
automation.reason.locks-unavailable: Browser locks are unavailable. Use semi-automatic mode.
automation.reason.another-tab: Another tab is processing this chat. Resume later.
automation.reason.stale-tab: This page differs from the saved chat. Reload and review.
automation.reason.read-failed: Could not read the saved chat. Processing stopped.
automation.reason.save-unconfirmed: Saving is not confirmed. Automatic hiding did not continue. Reconcile the interrupted operation.
automation.reason.fusion-invalid-range: Fusion selection or floor headings do not match the approved ranges. Restore the original headings and select existing summary blocks.
automation.reason.fusion-range-gap: These summaries contain a gap in covered floors. Fuse only adjacent summaries with consecutive floor ranges.
automation.reason.editor-target-changed: The original editor is no longer active. Your fullscreen text is preserved; copy it before closing and reopen the intended chat editor.
automation.reason.source-changed: Source messages or approved ranges changed and need review.
automation.reason.summary-changed: The summary changed or is being edited. Current text was not overwritten.
automation.reason.settings-changed: Settings changed during generation. Review the result manually.
automation.reason.range-gap: An earlier gap is smaller than a batch. Summarize it manually first.
automation.reason.hidden-source: The source range includes hidden or excluded messages. Review it manually first.
automation.reason.invalid-config: Batch size and retained message count must be positive integers.
automation.reason.result-needs-review: The result includes fallback content, a warning, or a recognized error. It was not automatically adopted or hidden.
automation.reason.generation-failed: The automatic operation failed and paused. Source text and existing summaries are retained. Review before resuming.
automation.reason.cancelled: Task cancelled. Automatic processing did not continue.
automation.reason.chat-changed: The chat changed. The old task cannot write to this chat.
automation.reason.busy: A chat or summary operation is still running. Try again later.
automation.reason.range-overlap: This range already has a summary. It was not adopted again.
automation.reason.recovery-required: A save or visibility operation is unfinished. Reconcile it first.
automation.reason.recovered: The interrupted operation was reconciled. Automation remains paused.
automation.reason.undo-unavailable: There is no recent automatic adoption to undo.
automation.reason.undo-conflict: The summary or source visibility changed. Undo cannot apply the old snapshot.
automation.reason.hidden-history: Source history is still automatically hidden. Undo the adoption or unhide it in SillyTavern before clearing the summary.
automation.reason.draft-unavailable: This chat has no draft to review.
automation.reason.draft-discarded: Draft discarded and automation paused to prevent regenerating the same range.
automation.reason.unsupported-state: Automation data uses an unsupported version. Data is preserved and processing stopped.
automation.reason.injection-disabled: The summary is saved, but hiding is blocked because automatic injection is disabled.
automation.reason.injection-unavailable: The summary is saved, but the selected injection layer is unavailable. Source messages were not hidden.
automation.reason.injection-empty: No usable summary injection is available. Source messages were not hidden.
automation.reason.injection-boundary: Automatic chat depth has no continuous summarized boundary. Choose a valid injection strategy before hiding.
automation.help.title: Automation usage guide
automation.help.start.title: Getting started
automation.help.start.body:
Automation applies only to this chat. New chats default to semi-automatic.
Save the independent API, summary preset and template settings first. Then choose a mode, batch size and recent-message reserve. Opt into hiding separately, and select “Save chat rules and check one batch.” Automatic tasks use saved settings, not unsaved form changes.
automation.help.modes.title: What each mode does
automation.help.modes.body:
Semi-automatic: select a range, generate a summary and confirm adoption yourself.
Generate drafts for review: generate when eligible, then wait for your review. Human approval does not automatically hide the source.
Generate and adopt automatically: save and adopt usable results. Source messages are hidden only if you also enable the separate hiding option.
automation.help.schedule.title: When it runs: one batch per trigger
automation.help.schedule.body:
Each user or character message counts as one floor. Batch size is the number summarized in one operation. The reserve keeps that many recent messages outside the source range.
Saving rules or resuming checks one batch. Later, each completed character reply schedules another check once SillyTavern is idle. Existing history is not drained in a continuous loop. Sending only a user message, opening the panel or waiting does not independently trigger another batch.
automation.help.example.title: Example: 65 existing messages, batch 20, reserve 10
automation.help.example.body:
Enabling automation first summarizes floors 1–20 and, if enabled, hides only those 20 messages. “Completed” means this batch is complete, not that all history has been summarized.
The next completed character reply checks floors 21–40. Floors 41–60 need at least 70 total messages to leave the final 10 untouched, and are processed on a subsequent trigger. “Next summary floors” shows a candidate range, not a running task.
automation.help.editing.title: Continuing after fusion or editing
automation.help.editing.body:
Editing the cumulative summary, saving changes or running Merge & Compress pauses automation. Unsaved summary text and fullscreen editing also block automatic appends.
After saving, select “Resume and check one batch” in the workspace. Later summaries append to your edited cumulative text without replacing it or restarting from floor 1.
Keep range headings such as “【第1次总结】(楼 1-20)” when editing. Fusion uses these headings to identify covered ranges. Only adjacent summaries with consecutive floor ranges can be fused. Mismatched headings or changed sources block fusion and preserve the existing text.
automation.help.hiding.title: Hiding is separate from adoption
automation.help.hiding.body:
Hiding happens only after automatic adoption, confirmed saving and usable injection. It excludes the source under SillyTavern’s visibility rules without deleting chat records. The recent-message reserve is left untouched.
Switching to semi-automatic or clearing the hiding option affects future operations. It does not unhide earlier ranges. Restore them using an available undo operation or SillyTavern’s own unhide controls.
automation.help.controls.title: Pause, resume and check another historical batch
automation.help.controls.body:
Pause stops further automatic work while retaining existing summaries and visibility. Resume checks one batch rather than processing the entire backlog.
To check another historical batch without continuing the conversation, pause and then select “Resume and check one batch.” Each check still follows the batch and reserve rules. Handle any pending draft or unresolved interrupted operation first.
automation.help.undo.title: What undo restores
automation.help.undo.body:
Only the latest undo point is retained. Undo restores the cumulative summary and ranges from before that adoption, and restores visibility for messages newly hidden by it. Automation remains paused afterward.
Saving edits, merging summaries or a later adoption invalidates or replaces an older undo point so it cannot overwrite newer text. Source-range or visibility changes can also block undo.
automation.help.troubleshooting.title: Why processing waits or pauses
automation.help.troubleshooting.body:
“Completed” without a pause: check whether another full character reply has arrived. Old history is not drained continuously.
Too few eligible messages or a recent-message reserve: continue chatting until the next batch is eligible.
Pending draft: approve or discard it first. Discard pauses automation to avoid regenerating the same range.
Changed sources, a small earlier gap, changed settings or manual editing: resolve the workspace notice, then resume.
Fallback or flagged output is not automatically adopted or hidden. If saving is unconfirmed, use “Reconcile interrupted operation” instead of generating the same range repeatedly. If injection is unavailable, enable it and choose a valid injection strategy.
automation.help.requirements.title: Requirements and scope
automation.help.requirements.body:
Automatic generation currently needs a saved, complete independent API configuration. Semi-automatic generation still supports the shared API.
The Memoir panel does not need to stay open. While the SillyTavern browser tab remains running, completed character replies can trigger automation; reopen the panel to view the result. Closing that tab or exiting the browser stops automation; it does not continue as a server background job.
Your browser must support safe automatic execution. If capabilities are unavailable, use a supported browser over HTTPS or localhost. Same-origin tabs coordinate operations; this does not coordinate simultaneous writes from other devices or extensions.
